topology_and_traffic.topology: new isolated five-node Linux path, separate from frozen Phase 6--8 and X5 evidence
topology_and_traffic.traffic: bounded deterministic hosta-to-hostb probe and throughput windows with recorded command/version/seed context
topology_and_traffic.mutation_owner: tc_netem_performance_collector:v1 owns only direct tc qdisc, filter and interface-counter observations

faults.mutation: tc netem loss on one declared egress
tc netem delay on one declared egress
declared competing bounded traffic source with no tc rate cap
tc tbf rate cap on one declared egress

contracts.baseline_thresholds: derived and frozen per topology/traffic context before any mutation; no threshold is inferred from fault windows
contracts.effectiveness: bounded state-based direct qdisc/config plus required feature postcondition; no arbitrary sleep defines effectiveness
contracts.recovery: intent before mutation, atomic journal, exact qdisc replay/removal, partial-mutation recovery, idempotent double recovery, baseline before/after and zero-container cleanup
contracts.rule_ownership: performance_rule_engine:v1 consumes only validated Feature Vector v2; collectors never classify
contracts.scientific_limit: design-only; no new performance evidence, dataset, model, metric, API change, generalized performance or multi-fault claim
